key_derivation: `git log -G"FLOW_FORMAT_VERSION" -- mitmproxy/version.py` returns 18 commits; mitmproxy/io/compat.py appears in every one of the 8 most recent (358fca3e7, 5ec4bbf49, 6b7106614, 362c19056, 6d67a405a, 8e1adbc5d, 6d2b823a5, eb65bc748), so the pair is invariant across four years. Completeness is checkable arithmetically rather than historically: FLOW_FORMAT_VERSION is 21 and converters' highest key is `20: convert_20_21`, so the chain from (0,11) to 21 is unbroken; bump the constant without adding a converter and migrate_flow raises on the previous format, which test_compat.py::test_load exercises
